product_one_liner.value: Jack is an AI career agent that helps job seekers find roles, while Jill is an AI recruiting agent that helps companies find candidates and introduces both sides when they match.

pricing_page.notes: The page publicly lists Jill plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: The Customers page features each as a company using Jill.

employee_band.notes: The company page states that the team has 28 people.

founded_year.notes: Companies House records incorporation in March 2025, and investor Air Street says the founders started Jack & Jill that month; the company llms.txt separately says 2024, so the founding-year sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows company, hiring, product and career-market editorial content, but not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public docs index links multiple guides, FAQs, feature articles, and integration instructions.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role list includes an engineering vacancy titled Founding Engineer, but no open role title names AI, ML, machine learning, data science, or another qualifying specialty.

model_provider.notes: A September 2026 capture of the Platform Terms reports these four model providers; the currently rendered terms page was less specific.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names UK GDPR; it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS. GDPR is listed because it is one of the requested items.

last_funding.notes: The company states the $40M Series A was raised on 15 September 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced on 15 September 2026, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive (SF) posting says the hire will build Jack & Jill’s San Francisco sales motion and be one of its first hires there.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index says Company Insights was live in Jill on 4 November 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete small team page identifies the CEO and CTO as co-founders; their profiles show April 2025 start dates, before the 12-month window beginning 2025-11-09. No C-level or VP departure is reported.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations index names ATS integrations and Slack, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
